audit.whatIsWrong: Nine fields (winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, report[9].t) name Hwei's key CC ability as 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. Hwei has no ability called that. His real spell tree is Q Subject: Disaster (damage paints), W Subject: Serenity (utility paints), E Subject: Torment (CC paints: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw), R Spiraling Despair. The CC lives on E.
audit.why: The kit file's enemyAbilities confirm E = Subject: Torment and it is the only CC-flagged slot, matching hardCC on E in enemyKit. This matches the calibration example (Brand's R fabrication) exactly — a plausible-sounding but nonexistent ability name shipped as the matchup-defining cooldown across nine fields.
audit.corrected: Replaced every instance with 'Subject: Torment (E)' and added the real cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) to breakdown.cooldowns, which also had no digit per lintFindings.

audit.why: Level chart (Zyra wins 1-3, Skill 4-6-item) matches packet.levelChart and win[N]/phases[N].side already agree.

Spikes correctly identify level 2 as Zyra's kill window (Hwei has no hard CC/dash at 2), level 6 as a trade rather than a kill since both ults telegraph, and late game as decided by combo sequencing. Grounded in real kit.

edits.after: Out-vote the poke mirror. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo's pattern works.

notes: Large fix: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' does not exist in Hwei's kit and was shipped across 9 fields as the matchup's named focus ability; replaced throughout with the real CC ability, Subject: Torment (E), and added its real per-rank cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) plus Zyra's R cooldown (110/100/90s) to satisfy the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT lint finding.
